**Decided here — file exports surface.** New subcommand of file, argv token exports. Accepts exactly one of: argv token module holding a module id, or a positional file path (same target shape as file show). Both or neither is invalid-arguments. Module form resolves the module and analyses that module's graph Path only, not every linked file. A module with no Path is a named absence, not a crash. Path form analyses the named file. The file need not be governed and need not be linked; unmarked source is the MODULE_MAP-dance input. A file linked to no module prints Module none (or Linked Modules none) and exits 0. Adapter resolution is LANGUAGE_ADAPTERS first-match, never a second list (F60). If an adapter supports the file, print adapter id, exportConfidence, and the sorted exports set. If exportConfidence is heuristic, the text says so on the same view; a list that omits that word is a failed criterion. If no adapter supports the file, print Adapter none, an empty export list, and the consequence sentence (contracts and health work; MODULE_MAP parity unverified); do not invent symbols. Missing file on disk is not-found. Output carries format text (default) and format json plus the json boolean shortcut, matching file show. JSON is a dedicated object (path, module id or none, adapter id or none, exportConfidence or none, exports array). It is not LintResult. D13 constrains lint JSON only: do not add a top-level key to LintResult. Read-only: no file write, no map rewrite, no fix argv token (D3).
